text:
deploy-bot: Canary update: canary v3.9.3 -> error-rate p95 spike 9.8% (> auto-rollback threshold 8%). Suggest AUTO-ROLLBACK to v3.9.2. See /deploy details: https://deploys.internal/runs/9421 :warning:
Olivia Chen: saw the spike, but this canary has dedicated customers on dedicated pools. auto rollback might cause sessions to fail. who owns first contact for those customers?
Matt R: Agree. For Dedicated we prefer manual coordination. We should pause the auto-rollback and start a manual rollback window. @deploy-bot can you pause auto actions for this release?
deploy-bot: auto actions paused by request of Olivia Chen. Canary traffic frozen at 8%.
Jess K: Quick health check — are the failures tied to KVCACHE hotpath again? Logs show `kvcache.eviction` errors around the same time.
Samir Patel: yes, stacktrace matches the K/V cache regression introduced in the memory allocator change. I can hotfix but needs a redeploy and re-run canary. We have two options: 1) manual rollback to v3.9.2 now, or 2) patch + canary retest (longer).
Lee (oncall): customer impact: two Dedicated accounts report degraded latency. Both are in EMEA. They want immediate rollback. Ops channel already notified.
Olivia Chen: decision: manual rollback now. Notify the two customers, schedule patch afterwards. I'll take lead on comms. @Matt R can you execute the rollback and confirm drain plan?
Matt R: On it. Steps: 1) pin routing to v3.9.2 for dedicated pools; 2) scale up v3.9.2 pods to match capacity; 3) gracefully drain v3.9.3; 4) unfreeze traffic shift. Using runbook snippet below:
```
# rollback runbook (short)
deploybot rollback --to v3.9.2 --scope dedicated
kubectl scale deployment inference-v3.9.2 --replicas 12 --namespace=prod
deploybot pin-version --env prod --model default --version v3.9.2
monitor p95, error-rate, kvcache.evictions
```
Jess K: I'll monitor metrics and KV cache errors. If anything else pops up, I have a canary redalert channel.
Samir Patel: I'll prepare the memory-allocator revert branch, but hold merge until rollback completes.
Olivia Chen: Comms — sending customer note now: short explanation, ETA 30m, will follow up with postmortem. cc: @CustomerSuccess.
Matt R: Executing rollback now. `deploybot rollback` initiated.
deploy-bot: Rollback started by Matt R. Rolling back dedicated pools to v3.9.2. Estimated 12m.
oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2026-0308-14, paging rotation notified.
Lee (oncall): Verified dedicated pool pin applied. Traffic shift at 30% -> 0. Keep an eye on session errors.
Jess K: p95 dropping back towards baseline, error-rate 1.2% now.
Samir Patel: Nice. I'll hold the branch. Plan to re-run canary with allocator revert in staging tomorrow morning.
Olivia Chen: Good work. Postmortem owners: Samir (root cause & fix), Jess (telemetry), Olivia (customer comms). We'll file a short release note: manual rollback due to kv cache regression. :white_check_mark:
Matt R: Closing the thread after monitoring completes. Ping here once postmortem link is up.
Olivia Chen: postmortem PR: https://git.internal/postmortems/INC-2026-0308-14
